subject.title: feat(agents): sessions_search tool for full-text recall over past session transcripts

question: Should direct `sessions.search` be an advertised `operator.read` RPC that can search the default agent without an explicit session-key allowlist, or should transcript search require a caller-derived allowlist or narrower scope before merge?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but this is a new privacy-sensitive transcript discovery API and stored index; code review cannot choose the permanent gateway authorization boundary or upgrade contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require Allowlisted Search
options.body: Make direct gateway calls require authorized `sessionKeys` or equivalent caller context so broad transcript discovery stays behind the agent/tool visibility layer.

options.title: Accept Operator-Read Discovery
options.body: Keep the PR shape and document that full-text transcript discovery is normal trusted operator read access for this gateway.

options.title: Hold For Security Review
options.body: Pause merge until a security owner signs off on the read scope, redaction, and stored-index model.

recommendation.title: Require Allowlisted Search
recommendation.body: Make direct gateway calls require authorized `sessionKeys` or equivalent caller context so broad transcript discovery stays behind the agent/tool visibility layer.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the linked feature issue and adjacent session-management direction, making him the best available owner for this product/security boundary choice.
